import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-staggered-bottleneck/tools'))
import seal_case as seal
specs=[('20261103_midflow_baseline71_24','baseline71_24',24,18,6,'evidence_complete24.tar','baseline24_summary_v1'),('20261103_midflow_V2_screen73_6','projected_predecessor_v2_screen73_6',6,3,3,'evidence_complete6.tar','V1V2screen18_summary_v1')]
plans=[]
for bname,sname,count,prune_count,keep_count,aname,mechanism_name in specs:
    batch=root/'tmp/staggered_bottleneck'/bname;stage=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered'/sname
    proof=seal.read(stage/(aname+'.verification.json'));meta=seal.read(stage/(aname+'.manifest.json'));archive=stage/(aname+'.gz')
    assert proof['cases_verified']==proof['protocol_verified']==proof['physical_safe_count']==proof['all_completed_count']==count
    assert not proof['original_paths_required'] and not proof['original_repository_reads'] and proof['archive_original_bytes_compared']
    assert seal.sha(archive)==meta['sha256'] and archive.stat().st_size==meta['bytes']
    records=seal.read(batch/'manifest.json');protocol=seal.read(batch/'protocol.json');assert len(records)==len(protocol['tasks'])==count
    keys=lambda r:(r['candidate'],r['flow'],r['seed'],r['scenario'],r['mode'])
    assert len({keys(r) for r in records})==count and {keys(r) for r in records}=={keys(r) for r in protocol['tasks']}
    mechanism=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered/diagnosis'/mechanism_name/'source_windows.json'
    mech=seal.read(mechanism);mi={r['case_dir']:r for r in mech['cases']}
    out=stage/'raw_pruning';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);index=[]
    for r in records:
        assert r['flow'] in (1500.,1750.,2000.) and r['safe'] is True and r['all_completed'] is True and r['status']=='drained' and r['returncode']==0 and r['seal_status']=='verified'
        if count==24:
            assert r['candidate']=='S' and r['seed'] in (71,72) and r['scenario'] in ('lane_drop','straight3') and r['mode'] in ('noa','transform')
            keep=r['seed']==71 and r['scenario']=='lane_drop'
        else:
            assert r['candidate']=='W' and r['seed'] in (73,74) and r['scenario']=='lane_drop' and r['mode']=='transform'
            keep=r['seed']==73
        folder=Path(r['evidence_dir']);saved=seal.read(folder/'seal.json');seal.verify(folder,False)
        assert mi[r['run_dir']]['positions_sha256']==saved['originals']['positions.jsonl.gz']['sha256'] and mi[r['run_dir']]['window_complete']
        for name,e in saved['originals'].items():
            p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
            assert not e.get('missing') and p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']
        index.append(dict(candidate=r['candidate'],flow=r['flow'],seed=r['seed'],scenario=r['scenario'],mode=r['mode'],run_dir=r['run_dir'],evidence_dir=r['evidence_dir'],keep_full_raw=keep,originals=saved['originals']))
    assert sum(not r['keep_full_raw'] for r in index)==prune_count and sum(r['keep_full_raw'] for r in index)==keep_count
    seal.write(out/'raw_index_before_pruning.json',index);(out/'mechanism_source_windows.json').write_bytes(mechanism.read_bytes())
    plans.append((batch,stage,out,index,meta,mechanism,prune_count,keep_count))
summaries=[]
for batch,stage,out,index,meta,mechanism,prune_count,keep_count in plans:
    changes=[]
    for r in index:
        if r['keep_full_raw']:
            changes.append({**r,'deleted':[],'bytes_released':0});continue
        changed=seal.prune_raw(Path(r['run_dir']),batch,r['originals'],verified=True)
        assert set(changed['deleted'])==set(seal.RAW_FILES);seal.verify(Path(r['evidence_dir']),False)
        changes.append({**r,**changed})
    for r in index:
        for name,e in r['originals'].items():
            p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
            assert (p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']) if r['keep_full_raw'] else not p.exists()
    result=dict(cases=changes,pruned_successful_cases=prune_count,retained_full_raw_cases=keep_count,bytes_released=sum(r['bytes_released'] for r in changes),archive_sha256=meta['sha256'],mechanism_source_windows_sha256=seal.sha(mechanism),only_predeclared_success_raw_pruned=True,no_recursive_delete=True,failed_cases_pruned=0,original_manifest_and_seals_unchanged=True,old_batches_untouched=True)
    seal.write(out/'pruning_verification.json',result);summaries.append(dict(stage=stage.name,**{k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='cases'}))
print(json.dumps(summaries))
